summary: An announcement of a working meeting on the Telnet protocol, to be held at UCLA on March 5, 1973. Many changes and extensions had been proposed since RFC 318, and the aim was to agree on an official protocol with some room for optional features. Attendees were expected to have read a list of earlier RFCs.

eli5.summary: A call for people to meet and finally agree on the rules for connecting to faraway computers by typing, after lots of competing ideas.
